note: The ffmpeg engine draws with headless Chrome and pure renderAt(t, data) pages. It runs the renderat runtime and the hf runtime (an admitted HyperFrames component, the second page contract: only the entries of blocks/hf/allowlist.json that carry a recorded determinism test), so it draws every block that has an implementation for one of them and refuses the others. presets names the block that draws each preset by default; a beat may name another block of the same preset. The aside (oh:aside) draws its label; its grey and its echo are the compose's (a mono grade, an aecho on the sound).
